## Overview
[Record] A crusading order that settled in Prussia in 1226-30 and ruled it from Marienburg. In this saga's years it is the Grand Duchy's chief enemy and its main source of hostages and treaties. Grand Masters: Winrich von Kniprode (1351-24 Jun 1382), [Konrad Zöllner von Rotenstein](../characters/zollner.qmd) (elected 5 Oct 1382, d. 20 Aug 1390), Konrad von Wallenrode (1391-93), Konrad von Jungingen (1393-1407), [Ulrich von Jungingen](../characters/jungingen.qmd) (1407, killed at Grunwald 15 Jul 1410), Heinrich von Plauen (1410-13), Michael Küchmeister (1414-22), Paul von Rusdorf (1422-41). Key dates: Dovydiškės 31 May 1380; Dubysa 31 Oct 1382; Königsberg 30 Jan 1384; Salynas 12 Oct 1398; First Peace of Thorn 1 Feb 1411; Melno 27 Sep 1422; Christmemel 19 Jun 1431; Brest 31 Dec 1435; the Prussian Confederation, 1440.

## Wants (by book)
| Book | Goal | Leverage | Red line |
|---|---|---|---|
| VI | Break the Pact's guard on the west border | Reise raids; Kęstutis's capture, 1361 | Strėva and Rudau are wins, not conquest |
| I | Keep the cousins at war; buy Samogitia from each (Dubysa, Königsberg) | [Ona](../characters/ona.qmd) and the sons as surety; the baptism of [Vytautas](../characters/vytautas.qmd) (I ch. 19, 29) | Lithuania must not be baptised |
| II | Use Vytautas again; win Samogitia by Salynas | Hostages, incl. [Žygimantas](../characters/zygimantas.qmd) (1390-98) and the sons (II ch. 7-10) | Losing the land bridge |
| III | Hold Samogitia; stop the Polish-Lithuanian alliance | The best army in the Baltic | Marienburg and Danzig |
| IV | Win the propaganda war at Constance; back the crown to split the union | Falkenberg's tract; papal friends | A baptised Lithuania |
| V | Back Švitrigaila (Christmemel 1431), then drop him (Brest 1435) | The Livonian branch | The crusade's legitimacy |

## Patron Force
[Saga] [Geležinis Šventasis](../forces/iron_saint.qmd), fed by the Reise and forced baptism. Signs: furnace heat in winter, crosses that ring like anvils. It screams at Grunwald (Book III ch. 20).

## Internal tensions
The Livonian branch has its own Landmeister and feuds. The Prussian towns drift to the Confederation (1440). Plauen is deposed after Marienburg. Feuds: [Vytautas](../characters/vytautas.qmd), whom it baptised and armed in 1383 and who burned Marienwerder and Georgenburg in July 1384 (see the [Order's sword](../artifacts/order_sword.qmd)), and who defected again in 1392, the year his hostage sons died. Poland and Lithuania after Grunwald.

## Notable members
[Kniprode](../characters/kniprode.qmd), [Zöllner](../characters/zollner.qmd), [Hohenstein](../characters/hohenstein.qmd), [Ulrich von Jungingen](../characters/jungingen.qmd).
